The LactoSure ECO is India's fastest ultrasonic milk analyzer. It measures: Fat, SNF, CLR, Protein, Lactose, Added Salt, Added Water, and Temperature. For low battery / not charging: 1) Connect the charger adapter and charge the battery fully (may take 4-6 hours for first charge). 2) Check if the charger LED indicator is lit. 3) Try a different power socket. 4) If still not charging, the battery may need replacement — book a service visit. For solar variant: ensure solar panel is getting adequate sunlight.

For display issues: 1) Check if the machine is powered on (LED indicator). 2) Try turning it off and on again. 3) Check the display cable connections inside. 4) If using an external display (LactoSure EXD), ensure the cable is properly connected. If the issue persists, book a service visit.

For inaccurate readings: 1) Clean the measuring cell thoroughly with warm water. 2) Use fresh, properly mixed milk sample at room temperature. 3) Run calibration with standard samples. 4) Check if the ultrasonic stirrer is working properly. 5) Ensure the sample temperature is within range. If readings are still off, book a service visit for recalibration.

For VIBRO Ultrasonic Stirrer issues: 1) Check power connection and LED indicator. 2) Ensure the stirrer probe is clean and not damaged. 3) Check if the ultrasonic transducer is working (you should feel vibration). 4) Verify the sample volume is adequate. 5) If no vibration at all, the transducer may need replacement. Book a service visit if the issue persists.

For LactoSure DPS-T (DPU) issues: 1) Check power supply connection. 2) Verify the analyzer-to-DPU cable is properly connected. 3) Restart the DPU. 4) Check if data is syncing between analyzer and DPU. 5) If the display on DPU is blank, try reconnecting the display cable. For persistent issues, book a service visit.

For printer issues: 1) Check if printer has paper and paper roll is loaded correctly. 2) Verify printer is connected to the analyzer/DPU. 3) Check if the printer driver is configured. 4) Try printing a test report. 5) If the printer head is dirty, clean it gently with isopropyl alcohol. If still not working, book a service visit.
